title: Reduced Payment Plan Percentage for Documented Job Loss and Reduced Income
content:
**Rule.** For a Reduced Payment Plan of the Hardship Assistance Programs, the documented-hardship percentage is set by the hardship reason on the request and the documents recorded on it: a request for job loss with at least one termination notice recorded on it uses 40 percent; a request for reduced income with at least one income statement recorded on it uses 45 percent; any other request uses the program's reduced payment percent.

## Percentage table

| Hardship reason on the request | Document recorded on the request | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| job loss | at least one termination notice | 40 |
| reduced income | at least one income statement | 45 |
| any other combination | — | the program's reduced payment percent |

A document counts only when it is recorded on the request itself as a document received; a borrower's description of a document is not a recorded document.

## Hypothetical combinations

| Reason | Documents recorded | Percentage |
|---|---|---|
| job loss | one termination notice | 40 |
| job loss | an income statement only | the program's reduced payment percent |
| reduced income | two income statements | 45 |
| reduced income | a termination notice only | the program's reduced payment percent |
| medical hardship | an income statement | the program's reduced payment percent |
